what: A square-cell grid (column count set to fit the width) that divides the button height into 4 rows lights up one cell at a time in random order on hover and fills with inverse-color pixels. Progress runs straight (ease none) from 0→1 in .38s, and a cell turns on when it passes its preset threshold (.02~.98). On release it turns off in reverse at the same speed (only the remaining amount if released midway). With the text set to difference blending, it flips by itself over the cells. It also fills on keyboard focus (:focus-visible).

options.dur: Time to fill completely (s), default .38 — shrinks with the remaining distance
options.back: Reverse-spin speed multiplier on release, default 1 (original download button is 1.5 — rewind .2s)
options.narrow: Interaction response turned off below this width (px), default 1024
options.--fx-tile: Cell color variable (style or the consumer’s CSS), default --kf-ink

note: To keep text legible over the cell, set the text to mix-blend-mode: difference (as in the original) or pick a text color that contrasts with both the background and the cell

from.where: Every page .pbtn — the ”Explore Tech”, roadmap and app store buttons (original analytics bundle pbtn tiles: 4 rows, .38s, threshold .02+.96, off below 1024), and the closing download button uses dur .3 and back 1.5 (original DownloadButton fill .3s, rewind timeScale 1.5)
